task.claim:
For every natural modulus q with 2 <= q, the two distinct natural numbers
0 and q have equal images in ZMod q:

    (0 : ZMod q) = (q : ZMod q).

Hence residue equality alone does not imply equality of represented natural
values. The exact bounded repair is also required: for all naturals x and y,
if x < q, y < q, and their casts to ZMod q are equal, then x = y.

This is a counterexample and an injectivity lemma about ZMod q. It is not a
theorem about the soundness of any named proof system or circuit.
